title.en: One antimatter particle, months of control—and a physics test still to come
title.zh: 一颗反物质粒子，受控数月，下一场物理检验仍待完成

summary.en: Northwestern resolves individual positron quantum states; a sharper matter–antimatter comparison remains a future measurement.
summary.zh: 西北大学分辨并控制单颗正电子量子态；更精确的物质与反物质比较仍待测量。

title.en: Europe proposes making one cookie refusal last at least four months
title.zh: 欧洲拟让一次Cookie拒绝，至少四个月不再被追问

summary.en: The Council mandate combines simpler consent and incident reporting with safeguards; it still requires negotiations and adoption.
summary.zh: 理事会谈判立场拟简化同意及事件报告，同时保留保障；仍待谈判与立法。
